notes.title: Some Major Under the Hood Changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I hope you're enjoying your Memorial Day weekend. Many thanks to our servicemen and women!

I've spent much of the past 48 hours rolling my face back and forth across the keyboard. Despite these repeated episodes of resignation, I managed to update the Disc Golf project to Unity 6 and transition from the soon-to-be-retired Built-in Render Pipeline to the Universal Render Pipeline.

While the benefits of these changes might not be immediately obvious, they lay the groundwork for lots of good things to come.

One side effect of changing pipelines is that many of my custom shaders broke — including the one I used for water. I tried following some tutorials to build new ones, but as a Shader Graph rookie, it might as well have been black magic. Fortunately, I found a pretty solid water asset that I think looks pretty spiffy.

Let me know what you think!


TL;DR
- Updated to Unity 6
- Changed render pipeline from Built-In to URP

notes.title: Fix for multiplayer participation
notes.content: Fixed bug where player participation was getting set to false, even for players who had selected their character, in the main menu when progressing from character selection to course selection screens. A test method in the play scene would (undesirably) force all player participation to true if no players were found to be participating. This basically caused indexing errors with player iteration and the scorecard. Should be corrected now!

notes.title: v0.0.0.600
notes.content:
- Major overhaul to control scheme
- Pre meter routine directional input now controls launch angle of disc
- Directional input gathered during meter routine effects disc angle of attack
- Players can now invert vertical input through pause menu -> options panel. Only applies to player who paused.
- Scorecard should now display correct scores per player
- Scorecard now displays correct par per hole
- Scorecard Continue/Back buttons can no longer be navigated away from via directional input
- Improved multiplayer functionality
- Orbit cam vertical now controls vertical launch angle
- All players can pause the game at any time now and change their input settings.

notes.title: Misc bug fixes
notes.content:
- Continue/Back button for scorecard no longer deselect able with directional input

- Ensure all objects of a character with render components disable/enable those components when enabling/disabling a character
- Scorecard now shows proper score per hole
- Adjusted distances for auto selecting disc at start of turn
- Approximate max distance now displays over shot meter per disc type
